ai.title: Baidu results beat estimates as AI cloud surge offsets ad slump
ai.description: Baidu has announced strong quarterly results, surpassing market expectations. The company's cloud computing services showed significant growth, helping to compensate for a downturn in its advertising business. This surge in cloud demand is linked to increased enterprise adoption of artificial intelligence in China. Baidu's core AI-powered business, including cloud, saw a substantial revenue increase.
